a.title: ST-10A  ·  tracked straddle crawler
lines: Four twin-track crawler trucks (3.4 m tall, 10.5 m long) under two white box girders and a rear cross girder;
two 31 m cradle towers, three clamp arms per side (8.5 / 20 / 29 m) with rubber saddles; swing gate closes the open end.
a.footprint: 29.1 L x 27.4 W m, towers 32.5 m (ship 8.9 m dia, legs 18.5 m)
a.gear: 4 x twin-track trucks, tracks 3.4 m tall (1.9x astronaut)
a.cradle: 6 clamp arms + gate; arms retract 1.6 m when empty
a.game: ~10-12k tris, 7-8 draws (merge by material, track shoes as 1 strip each)

b.title: ST-10B  ·  multi-axle wheeled straddle (SPMT style)
lines: Two 4.2 m decks on 7 steerable pendulum axle lines each (28 lunar wheels, 2.5 m dia, grousers); rear portal arch;
four hydraulic knuckle arms grip the hull at 10 m, an A-frame mast holds a horseshoe stabiliser collar at 24.5 m.
b.footprint: 28.2 L x 28.5 W m, portal/collar 25.2 m
b.gear: 14 axle lines / 28 wheels, 2.5 m dia (1.4x astronaut)
b.cradle: 4 knuckle arms + upper collar (opens to the rear)
b.game: ~11-13k tris, 7-8 draws (wheels as low-poly 12-side, grousers baked to colour)
